records.title: 10-K
records.text: •Gross margin dollars increased $382.7 million and gross margin rate increased 60 basis points to 40.3% of net sales.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: •Comparable sales for stores open at least fifteen months, plus our e-commerce operations, increased $816.1 million, or 16.1%.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: •Inventory of $940.3 million represented a $19.0 million increase, or 2.1%, from 2019.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The combined gain on sale of distribution centers and associated consulting and other expenses increased our operating profit by $459.1 million and increased our diluted earnings per share by approximately $8.75 per share.
